title: Press QA
label: A print line seen from above. A rotary press prints one sheet per build; each sheet carries a grid of marks, one per test. The sheets slide right under an inspector whose beam turns each mark green as it passes. One build has a failing test: its mark turns red, the line stops it, and an arm flicks the sheet down a chute that loops under the line back to the press. It is printed again, passes on the second run and lands on a neat stack of passed builds, whose tally reads 212 tests passed and 1 caught.
heading:
Caught on the line,
not in production.
sub: Every build runs the full suite before it ships. A failure is pulled off the line, fixed and run again.
